deep_analysis:
CRITICAL but the tape is mixed, not uniformly against us: 49 closes in 24h, 39% WR, -1.89 USDT. Both directions are bleeding (LONG -1.33 over 34 trades, SHORT -0.56 over 15) — this is chop eating both sides, not a one-way market. The exit distribution remains the smoking gun: SL-family exits (atr_sl_hit 16T/1W/-1.32 + hard_max_loss 7T/0W/-0.87 + trail_arm_timeout 2T/0W) = 25T, 1W, -2.30 (4% WR). Trail-family (profit-monster-trail 12T/11W/+0.47 + atr_trail_hit 4T/4W/+0.22) = 16T, 15W, +0.69 (94% WR). We keep entering in chop; only entries that trend from the start pay.

OPEN TRADES:
1. BTC LONG (16251, +0.09%, 4.6h): stop already at 81510 vs entry 81507 — breakeven locked, risk-free. BTC is AT EMA300 with LEAN_BEAR linreg and STRONG_DOWN trend quality, so this LONG fights the 1m lean, but with the stop at breakeven there is nothing to do but hold. If it stops out at BE, no harm.
2. INJ LONG (16255, -0.01%, 0.9h): entry was RSI 64.0 — the upper edge of the band, not the 45-60 center we want. Since entry, INJ momentum has faded hard: regime confidence 85.1 at pick time -> 55.3 now, 16c change +1.43% -> +0.23%. Thesis is weakening, not broken. SL at 8.655 (-0.59%) is the line — if it tags, the entry was a chase and we pay the tuition. Would NOT re-open fresh at these conditions.

NEW PATTERN (verified 12h): even MID-BAND RSI longs are dying in this LOW-volatility chop — BLUR LONG RSI 62.5 lost -2.7% (trail_arm_timeout, never armed), DOT LONG RSI 52.6 lost -4.3% (atr_sl_hit). The winners were the same mid-band doji reclaims that actually moved: XPL RSI 49.2, DOGE 43.8, GMT 56.3, ONDO 56.1 — all profit-monster-trail exits. The signal isn't broken; the entries that stall never get trail protection. The filter set lets stalled chop positions live until ATR SL or hard_max_loss takes them.

INJ is LONG_BIAS (conf 55.3, fading); BLUR is SHORT_BIAS (conf 92); DOT is LONG_BIAS (conf 93.5, +2.25%/16c — strongest large-cap momentum). pattern_alerts:
PATTERN 1 (VERIFIED, n=41 exits, 24h): SL-family exits 25T/1W/-2.30 (4% WR) vs trail-family 16T/15W/+0.69 (94% WR). WINNING SIDE: trades that trend immediately from entry. Why we miss it: entry timing places us in chop — price stalls below the +0.40% trail arm, ATR SL or hard_max_loss collects. This is the 52/56 hard_max_loss lesson repeating hourly.

PATTERN 2 (VERIFIED, n=20, 7d): doji-bottom-long split by meta_rsi — RSI<40: 6T/1W/-0.32 (avg entry RSI 25.4, knife catches); 40-50: 9T/4W/-0.18; 50+: 5T/3W/-0.12. WINNING SIDE: mid-band reclaims (RSI 43-56) that get follow-through — XPL 49.2, DOGE 43.8, GMT 56.3, ONDO 56.1, all trail exits. Why we miss it: sub-40 entries read oversold as a bottom; in a declining tape, indecision resolves down. Sub-40 doji longs are 1W/6L — brain auditor should gate these, not the whole signal.

PATTERN 3 (VERIFIED, n=16, 7d): volume-breakout-long 3W/13%/-0.94, worst signal by total PnL. WINNING SIDE: fade the failed breakout — most 'breakouts' in LOW volume_regime reverse within 2 candles. We buy expansion in a contractive tape.

PATTERN 4 (NEW, 12h): mid-band RSI longs dying to trail_arm_timeout — BLUR RSI 62.5 -2.7%, DOT RSI 52.6 -4.3%. WINNING SIDE was the trend-ride that followed on DOT (+2.25%/16c now); we were on the right coin and wrong entry candle, stopped before momentum started. Entry-thesis check at +30min would catch these: if price hasn't moved +0.15% in 30 minutes, the trail will never arm — exit early into the next opportunity.
